messages.subject: Project Drake — SPA mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our redline attached. The principal changes: escrow reduced to 12 months; de minimis up to £40k and threshold up to £350k (and on a true excess basis); general warranty cap reduced to 20%; and the non-compete shortened to two years. The balance is largely drafting. Happy to talk it through on a call.

Adam

messages.subject: FW: Project Drake — SPA mark-up (internal)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Mark,

Sellers' redline in. Their asks are predictable: shorter escrow (12m), higher de minimis/threshold, lower cap (20%) and a 2-year non-compete. My recommendation is we land somewhere in the middle — 15-month escrow, £35k/£300k, 22.5% cap, and a 30-month non-compete given the customer concentration. Mark, are you comfortable with that landing zone before I respond?

James
